sources.title: Evidence-Guided Capability Transfer Model
sources.role: Protected historical and semantic baseline.
sources.boundary: Internal source assertion; operational evidence still required for new claims.

sources.title: Deep Research Atlas v1.2
sources.role: Coverage ledger, confounders, disconfirmation, probability referent, provenance, completion gate.
sources.boundary: Research protocol; domain evidence remains with the cited sources.

sources.title: FDA Quality Management System Regulation
sources.role: Current quality-system context; effective 2 February 2026.
sources.boundary: Incorporated ISO text was not reproduced in the page.

sources.title: FDA Premarket Submissions for Device Software Functions
sources.role: Architecture, requirements, traceability, verification, versions, anomaly disposition.
sources.boundary: Product-specific documentation level unresolved.

sources.title: FDA Computer Software Assurance, February 2026
sources.role: Risk-proportional assurance and evidence records.
sources.boundary: Applies to production/QMS software, not device software functions themselves.

sources.title: FDA Cybersecurity in Medical Devices, February 2026
sources.role: Threat model, architecture, SBOM, testing, logging, recovery, vulnerability management.
sources.boundary: Section 524B duties depend on cyber-device status.

sources.title: FDA Human Factors Submission Information, May 2026
sources.role: Critical-task delta, URRA, validation evidence.
sources.boundary: Within stated operationalization interval through 1 August 2026.

sources.title: FDA Applying Human Factors and Usability Engineering
sources.role: Use-related risk foundation.
sources.boundary: Does not itself determine submission category.

sources.title: FDA Clinical Decision Support Software, January 2026
sources.role: Non-Device CDS criteria, independent review, time criticality, genomic examples.
sources.boundary: Device status cannot be concluded without intended use and actual function.

sources.title: IMDRF SaMD Clinical Evaluation
sources.role: Clinical association, analytical validation, clinical validation.
sources.boundary: International technical document, not a standalone US legal requirement.

sources.title: 21 CFR 11.10
sources.role: Validation, copies, retention, access, audit trail, authority and sequence checks.
sources.boundary: Predicate-rule and record-scope analysis required.

sources.title: 45 CFR 164.308 and 164.312
sources.role: Risk analysis, access, contingency, audit, integrity, authentication, transmission security.
sources.boundary: Applicability depends on entity, relationship, and ePHI.

sources.title: NIH Controlled-Access Data Requirements
sources.role: Approved use, security, incident reporting, institutional accountability.
sources.boundary: Conditional on controlled-access data and agreements.

sources.title: CMS Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments
sources.role: US human-laboratory testing boundary.
sources.boundary: No genomic-viewer-specific software rule was established by this page.

sources.title: NIST SSDF 1.1
sources.role: Secure development, provenance, verification, response.
sources.boundary: Voluntary framework, not certification; draft 1.2 excluded.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-207 Zero Trust Architecture
sources.role: Per-request policy decisions and enforcement; least privilege.
sources.boundary: General architecture; product policy topology unresolved.

sources.title: RFC 9700 OAuth 2.0 Security BCP
sources.role: Audience-restricted and sender-constrained token guidance.
sources.boundary: Does not establish the product’s identity protocol.

sources.title: Fowler — Original Strangler Fig Application
sources.role: Gradual replacement and frequent release framing.
sources.boundary: Pattern description, not proof of product separability.

sources.title: AWS Strangler Fig Pattern
sources.role: Proxy and anti-corruption boundary with risks and limitations.
sources.boundary: Implementation choice and domain boundary remain product-specific.

sources.title: Fowler — Branch by Abstraction
sources.role: Inner boundary, coexisting implementations, feature-flagged switching.
sources.boundary: Requires a viable abstraction; not always available.

sources.title: LaunchDarkly Multi-stage Migrations
sources.role: Old-only, dual-write, shadow, live, ramp-down, complete; selectable profiles.
sources.boundary: Not all systems support coexisting implementations.

sources.title: AWS Transactional Outbox
sources.role: Avoid uncoordinated dual writes; atomic state and event commit.
sources.boundary: Duplicate delivery still requires idempotent consumers.

sources.title: Debezium Outbox and CDC Features
sources.role: Change capture, deletes, transaction metadata, engine limitations.
sources.boundary: Connector-specific constraints remain.

sources.title: PostgreSQL Logical Replication Restrictions
sources.role: DDL, sequence, large-object, view, and conflict limitations.
sources.boundary: Database-specific; PostgreSQL use is not asserted.

sources.title: Istio Traffic Mirroring
sources.role: Fire-and-forget mirror whose response is discarded.
sources.boundary: Does not prevent stateful side effects by itself.

sources.title: Google SRE Workbook — Canarying Releases
sources.role: Canary/control separation, representative metrics, evaluation windows.
sources.boundary: Operational practice, not product validation or compliance proof.

sources.title: Google SRE — Service Level Objectives
sources.role: User-centered indicators, SLOs, and error-budget release posture.
sources.boundary: Thresholds must be locally defined.

sources.title: OpenAPI Specification
sources.role: Language-neutral interface description.
sources.boundary: Declared contract is not a verified contract.

sources.title: Pact Provider Verification
sources.role: Replay consumer assumptions against the provider.
sources.boundary: Does not replace data, security, production, or end-to-end evidence.

sources.title: W3C PROV-O
sources.role: Entities, activities, agents, usage, derivation, attribution, responsibility.
sources.boundary: Provenance semantics do not establish a regulatory regime.

sources.title: AWS Controlled Stop and Retirement Guidance
sources.role: Dependency evidence and reversible controlled stop.
sources.boundary: Business cycles and retention thresholds remain system-specific.

sources.title: Microsoft Decommission Source Workloads
sources.role: Approvals, success criteria, rollback grace, archival, recovery testing.
sources.boundary: General cloud guidance, not regulated-product approval.

sources.title: FDA Deciding When to Submit a 510(k) for a Software Change
sources.role: Intended-use and risk-change assessment; change records.
sources.boundary: Specific to covered existing devices.

sources.title: FDA AI-Enabled Device PCCP Guidance
sources.role: Authorized modification description, protocol, criteria, impact assessment.
sources.boundary: Conditional branch only; not a generic migration shortcut.

sources.title: W3C WCAG 2.2 and complex-image guidance
sources.role: Keyboard/focus, reflow, contrast, redundant color, text equivalents.
sources.boundary: Conformance requires testing beyond this artifact’s design intent.

sources.title: W3C SVG 2 Document Structure
sources.role: Title and description semantics for meaningful SVG groups.
sources.boundary: Assistive-technology behavior still requires testing.
